title: Choose the visual world for yenus.dev /
question: The roll assigned the Split-Flap Departures Board. Keep it, take an alternate, or re-roll.

options.label: Split-Flap Departures Board
options.lineage: Solari split-flap boards and printed rail departure timetables
options.thesis: A career read like a station board: one glance tells you the role, where he has been, and how to reach him.
materials: split-flap tiles with a hinge seam
options.viewport: Black board housing full-bleed; the name and role flip in on flaps at monumental scale; a yellow timetable strip below carries the CV download and email as the primary actions.
options.risk: Becomes a gimmick if long-form copy is forced onto flaps; prose must live on the printed timetable sheets.

raised.raise: Signal orange is reserved for one state only: the live action (CV/contact).
Selected work: one lead project turns face-out full width, the rest stay as spines.
Unlit ghost flaps are drawn, not empty space.
The board is still at rest; motion only fires on arrival.
Depth by flat overlap only: no drop shadows, no gradients.
The server-rendered state is the animation's end state; reduced motion shows it directly.

options.label: Trace Waterfall
options.thesis: Career and projects as spans on one timeline, each expandable to its decision.
options.viewport: A root span named for the role; child spans for each employer stretch across a time axis.
options.risk: Familiar developer-tool look; drifts toward the generic dashboard the founder dislikes.

options.label: Mecha Crisis Wall
options.case: Fuses poorly: alarm framing misreads a calm architect for recruiters.

options.label: Pulp Paperback Rack
options.case: Fuses poorly: lurid covers undercut credibility.
options.kept: Face-out promotion of the lead item.

options.label: Hand-drawn Zine
options.case: Fuses poorly: cream paper is on the founder's no-list.
options.kept: Reduced motion renders the finished state.

options.label: Seven-Segment Displays
options.case: Near-duplicate of the assigned signage family with lower text range.

options.label: Bioluminescent Wake
options.case: Fuses poorly: the dark-plus-neon AI rut.

options.label: Layered Papercut
options.case: Fuses poorly: folk ornament has no tie to the subject.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: A clean developer portfolio: hero, projects grid, experience timeline.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from every other portfolio by design.
